summary: First backend test pass for Digital Heirloom/AI Twin. All 50 pytest cases passed (auth, archive CRUD, dashboard, interviewer SSE, twin SSE, voice TTS, voice STT 400-path, social import w/ Claude extraction, skills incl. webhook invoke, heirs, multi-user isolation, error cases).

minor.issue: Could not exercise the success path — no ffmpeg/sample audio available in this container. Only the empty-audio 400 path was validated.

Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation. Cosmetic — not REST-conformant but consistent across all create endpoints (archive/heirs/skills/imports). Tests were written to match actual behaviour.

Sets cookie with secure=True, samesite='none', and no domain — works behind the kubernetes ingress over HTTPS but will silently fail if the app is ever served over plain HTTP locally. Not a bug for this preview env.

action_items: Optional: have voice/transcribe success path tested manually with a real audio sample (test infra lacks ffmpeg).
Optional: switch resource-creation endpoints to status_code=201 for REST conformance (purely cosmetic).
Optional: tighten EmailStr handling — bad email returns 422 (FastAPI default) which is correct; but heirs router returns the raw EmailStr object via pydantic — verified serializes fine.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.get_current_user handles both cookie + Bearer header correctly; sessions filter out _id and use custom user_id. Good.
All Mongo reads use the {"_id": 0} projection consistently — no ObjectId leakage observed.
Interviewer & Twin SSE generators correctly persist user+assistant turns after the stream completes, including on save_as_memory. Verified by post-stream GET /conversation/{id}.
social_import handles code-fence stripping and non-list LLM responses defensively. extract_error is stored on the import record rather than raising.
skills.invoke uses httpx with 15s timeout and never raises — failures return {ok:false, status:0, error}. Good UX.
Multi-user isolation enforced via {user_id: user['user_id']} on every query — confirmed empty dashboard + 404 cross-user fetches for user2.
Minor: archive POST returns 200 (should ideally be 201). Same for heirs/skills/imports.

Minor: interviewer.send_message duplicates the SSE wire format ('data: ... 

').replace('

','

') is a no-op — safe but dead code.
Minor: voice.transcribe reads entire upload into memory before size check — OK for 25MB cap but could be stream-checked.
Minor: TwinMsgReq + InterviewerMessageRequest do not bound message length — consider a max_length to prevent oversized prompts.
test_credentials: Two test users seeded via mongosh. USER1 session_token=test_session_1_1782358256086 (user_id=test-user-1-1782358256086). USER2 session_token=test_session_2_1782358256086 (user_id=test-user-2-1782358256086). Pass via Authorization: Bearer <token>.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 users + 2 user_sessions docs in MongoDB (test_database). Tests created TEST_-prefixed entries/heirs/skills which were partially cleaned up; remaining TEST_ docs are safe to leave or sweep.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green for v1 scope. If frontend testing is requested next, the two seeded test sessions above can be set as session_token cookies on the preview origin (https://voice-clone-hub-20.preview.emergentagent.com) — see /app/auth_testing.md Step 3. Voice STT success path was not exercised (no audio sample in env); only the 400 empty-audio guard was validated. Social import successfully called Claude and extracted entries in this run (count > 0 verified).
